subject.title: improve(ios): guide first-run users into gateway onboarding

question: Should the iOS preview-tour first-run experience be rebased and adopted on top of the current onboarding refresh, or should this branch be narrowed or closed in favor of the newer onboarding direction?
rationale: The remaining blocker is partly a product choice: the PR adds a new preview/sample onboarding mode while main has since landed overlapping startup routing, configured-gateway, security-copy, and typography decisions.

options.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
options.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

options.title: Narrow to preview pieces
options.body: Extract only the sample-preview pieces maintainers still want and leave connection-path behavior to current main and focused onboarding PRs.

options.title: Pause or close this branch
options.body: Treat current main's onboarding refresh as the maintained direction if the preview-tour product surface is no longer desired.

recommendation.title: Rebase and adopt preview tour
recommendation.body: Keep the feature direction, but require a rebase onto current main with branded typography and fresh first-run/configured-user proof before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The configured-gateway routing fix is the clearest recent ownership signal for the overlapping startup/onboarding product decision.
